extracted.intended_audience: applicants to PHS/NIH fellowship (graduate students and postdoctoral fellowship candidates)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and required item list for the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form and associated biographical sketch content that applicants (and their sponsors) must provide for NIH/PHS fellowship applications. Covers biosketch formatting, fellowship-specific sections (training plan, aims, sponsor statements), vertebrate animal/hESC questions, budget items, and other mandatory attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch format and length
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include name, eRA Commons user name (credential), position title, education/training table, personal statement, positions and honors, contributions to science, and selected publications. Limit the entire biosketch to five pages per person.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: List education/training beginning with baccalaureate or other initial professional education; include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study. Add or delete rows as necessary to reflect the individual's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement in biosketch
rubrics_metrics.description: A short narrative describing the individual's qualifications and relevance to the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the person's expertise and past work make them suitable for their role in the proposal; may cite representative work. Example content: a brief statement of relevant experience and commitment to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: List professional positions and honors with dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include academic and non-academic positions, leadership roles, and elected fellowships or awards; provide start/end years and institutional affiliations where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe major contributions to science and provide representative citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a narrative of key contributions (e.g., methods developed, theoretical advances), followed by selected citations (with context) that exemplify those contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Completed and Ongoing)
rubrics_metrics.description: List recent and current research support with role, grant number, funding source, project title, dates and a brief description of the project's aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate ongoing and completed support; indicate the individual's role (e.g., PI, Co-PI, Site PI, Co-Investigator) and provide dates. Include subawards and multi-institutional project roles as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work link
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a URL to a complete list of published work (e.g., My NCBI bibliography).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a stable link (example: http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sites/myncbi/...) so reviewers can access the applicant's full bibliography.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form structure
rubrics_metrics.description: The supplemental form contains numbered sections for applicant/fellowship-specific information (Introduction, Applicant Background, Research Training Plan, Sponsor statements, Institutional commitment, Budget, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the form's section ordering and file-naming guidance when uploading attachments (the sample shows PDF filenames such as 14__Background_and_Goals_For_FT.pdf). The item repeated from Research & Related Other Project Information must be kept consistent with that primary form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative describing the applicant's prior training, dissertation and research experience, and goals for the fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe undergraduate/graduate research experiences, relevant projects, publications, cross-cultural or collaborative experiences, and how the fellowship fits career goals. Provide examples and evidence of past productivity and training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Training Plan (required elements)
rubrics_metrics.description: The training plan must include specific annotated files: Specific Aims; Research Strategy; Respective Contributions; Selection of Sponsor and Institution; Progress Report Publication List (for renewals); and Training in Responsible Conduct of Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload each required sub-document as instructed (example filenames provided). The Research Training Plan should clearly articulate aims, methodological approach, and training objectives during the fellowship period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: A concise Specific Aims page for the fellowship research/training project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, focused aims that the fellowship will support. The sample references an uploaded file named 15_Specific_Aims.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: A detailed description of the research approach, methods, and rationale for the proposed fellowship project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include study design, methods, expected results, and significance; upload as the designated Research Strategy file (example 16_Research_Strategy.pdf). Ensure clarity about how the project serves the applicant's training.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respective Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: A statement describing the respective contributions of the applicant, sponsor(s), and other significant contributors to the research/training plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify which tasks each person will perform, mentoring responsibilities, and how contributions support training goals. Use the indicated upload (example 17_Respective_Contributions.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Sponsor and Institution / Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide justification for the selection of the sponsor(s) and institution, and include Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sponsor statements should address mentorship plan, training environment, resources, time commitment, and how the mentor will support career development. Upload files as directed (example 18__Selection_of_Sponsor___Inst.pdf and Sponsor_and_Cosponsor_Statement.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (for Renewal applications)
rubrics_metrics.description: A publication list documenting progress for renewal (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include publications resulting from the prior award period; label and upload the file per instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: A plan and documentation of training in responsible conduct of research for the fellow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the RCR curriculum, format, frequency, and mentor involvement. Upload RCR training documentation (example 19__Training_in_Responsible_CR.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters describing collaborator/consultant commitments and roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide letters that confirm availability, roles, and contributions of outside collaborators; upload as Letters_of_Support.pdf.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of the institutional environment and the institution's commitment to the applicant's training.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail available resources, facilities, training opportunities, and institutional support for the trainee; upload as the designated file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals use and euthanasia compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used and, if euthanasia is involved, whether methods are consistent with AVMA guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes' to euthanasia, answer whether method is consistent with American Veterinary Medical Association (AVMA) guidelines. If 'No' to AVMA guidelines, describe the method and provide scientific justification. Include vertebrate animal description documentation (file referenced).

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed project involves select agent research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If select agents are used, provide required registration and compliance documentation as directed by the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: A plan describing how data, resources, or materials will be shared.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details on data sharing, repositories, timelines, and any restrictions; upload the Resource Sharing Plan file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe how key biological and chemical resources will be authenticated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include methods for authentication (e.g., cell line validation, reagent sourcing) and upload supporting documentation (Authentication_of_Key_Biological_and/or_Chemical_Resources.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (hESC) requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells, list the registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) or indicate that a registry line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time, check the box indicating that one from the registry will be used. Provide registry information when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree sought and expected completion date
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the degree to be sought during the proposed award and the expected completion date (MM/YYYY).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'other' is selected for degree, indicate the degree type. Example: PHD: Doctor of Philosophy; Expected Completion Date: 05/2021.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field of Training code
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the numeric/official field of training code for the current proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the field code and descriptor (example shown: 980 Social Work). Use the official field codes as required by the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current or prior Kirschstein-NRSA support disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the applicant has current or prior Kirschstein-NRSA support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, provide level, type, start and end dates (if known), and grant number (if known).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications for Concurrent Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the applicant has applications for concurrent support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'Yes', provide a description in an attached file explaining the nature and timing of the concurrent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship status and guidance for non-U.S. citizens
rubrics_metrics.description: Select citizenship status (U.S. Citizen, U.S. Citizen or Non-Citizen National, Non-U.S. Citizen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are a non-U.S. citizen with a temporary visa applying for an award that requires permanent residency and expect to obtain permanent residency by the start date, check the provided box to indicate that expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Sponsoring Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If changing sponsoring institution, provide the name of the former institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter the former institution name and any relevant tracking or grant transfer information as requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition and Fees (Budget) for fellowship applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether tuition and fees are requested and provide year-by-year amounts when funds are requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select 'None Requested' or 'Funds Requested' and provide amounts for Year 1 through Year N and a total funds requested (example shows amounts per year and a total of $87,656.00).

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior Fellowship Applicants: Salary and Stipend details
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior fellowship applicants must report present institutional base salary and provide stipend/salary details for the first year of the proposed fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide amount, academic period, number of months, federal stipend requested, and any supplementation from other sources (amount, number of months, type, and source).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplementary appendix materials may be uploaded as part of the application package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label appendix files clearly; tracking number and funding opportunity number are displayed on the form. Follow agency-specific appendix rules concerning allowed content.
